name: 49855 · Marquette, MI
findings: ZIP 49855 (Marquette) has 228 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49855 (Marquette) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49855 (Marquette) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
